title: Open Coffee common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every Open Coffee dataset (coffee places now; roasters, beans and gear later). Reference them by absolute $id plus a JSON pointer.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Permanent, opaque identifier. Never reused, never derived from a name, never deleted.

datetime.title: Timestamp
datetime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with time zone, for example 2026-11-05T14:00:00Z.

country_code.title: Country code
country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in upper case.

postal_code.description: Postal code as used locally, for example 80331.

location.title: Coordinates
location.description: WGS 84 coordinates of the entrance or building.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84); positive is north of the equator, for example 48.1371.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84); positive is east of Greenwich, for example 11.5754.

image.title: Image
image.description: An openly licensed image. Each image carries its own licence, author and source.

url.description: Where the file is served from (our assets folder or the original host).

licence.description: SPDX identifier, for example CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0 or CC0-1.0.

author.description: Name of the photographer or creator, as the licence requires it to be credited.

source_url.description: Page describing the original file and its licence.

title.description: Short caption describing what the image shows.

width.description: Width of the image file in pixels.

height.description: Height of the image file in pixels.

external_ref.title: External reference
external_ref.description: A pointer to a record in another service. Never stores the other service's values.

source.description: Short name of the other service, for example tripadvisor or untappd. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

id.description: The record's identifier in the other service.

dataset_meta.title: Dataset metadata

licence.description: Licence of the file: MIT, with the copyright notice “Roastbook Open Coffee contributors”.

dataset_meta.description: File-level facts that are not records. The schema version is the $schema URL; the data version is the release tag.
